children.text: Welcome to the home page of the Sigma Delta Sigma chapter of Phi Beta Sigma Fraternity Inc. Woodstock, GA is our base of operation, but we are dedicated to providing services in the name of Sigma where we are needed. We invite you to check out our website to learn more about our chapter and Phi Beta Sigma.
Phi Beta Sigma Fraternity, Inc. was founded on January 9, 1914, at Howard University in Washington, D.C.
Our motto: Culture For Service and Service For Humanity.
